subject: Australia
purpose: Behind-the-scenes coverage index; source cards are not automatically atomic mastery skills.
limitations: This indexes every tip card in the current guide, not every possible Australian clue.
Plate, phone-code and bus-stop charts are aggregates needing finer-grained decomposition and visual validation.
An existing metadata match is not evidence that all bundled features are visible at every tagged panorama.
Source image and short-map URLs are references, not validated playable location coordinates.
Camera generations, rare cars and coverage-absence claims are time-sensitive.
Exclusivity wording is source testimony; learn exceptions and use held-out examples.
No learner mastery or performance has been inferred from source coverage.
Some inline links are comparison foils, including New Zealand. Do not assign every candidate its surrounding card target label or import all candidates into an Australia-only set.
